title: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint
summary: Bonsai 2 is a 27B parameter language model that achieves near-lossless quality while compressed to a 9x smaller footprint (roughly 3B equivalent), making it dramatically more efficient for deployment without significant quality degradation.
problem_solved: Reduces the computational and memory requirements for running large language models by up to 9x while maintaining near-original quality.
why_valuable: Makes powerful AI capabilities accessible on consumer hardware and reduces cloud inference costs significantly.
